strengths: Sensor/actuator/compute integration is the strongest match: COFFIN capstone integrates Jetson + Arduino + five servos + dual VL53L0X ToF sensors behind a TCA9548A I2C mux, with contact-aware grasping and a 10/10 pick reliability result.

Hardware validation and failure-mode documentation: COFFIN 'Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture)' is direct evidence of the debug-and-document loop the JD describes.

Collaboration with AI/systems teams for data collection: COFFIN 'LeRobot-structured data collection pipeline using multiprocessing for multi-camera frame capture' maps almost exactly to the hardware-for-data-collection responsibility.

Motor/drive hardware depth: Robocon robot has 4x Cytron motor drivers, 15 kHz PWM, interrupt-driven quadrature decoding, and 'owned wiring, interfacing, and integration across mechanical and design teams'.
Bonus items are genuinely covered: Arduino, STM32, Raspberry Pi, Jetson, ROS 2 (UR5e/AL5B with MoveIt), robot arm kinematics, sensor integration, motor control.
Bench instruments are listed (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters) and backed by an EAGLE PCB fabrication line in the Agnel Robotics Club entry.

screening_gaps: Student-status eligibility: JD says 'currently pursuing a degree'; a May 2026 graduate may be filtered out for a Spring 2027 internship unless the program accepts recent graduates.
No soldering or breadboarding on the resume: the first hands-on requirement is not evidenced anywhere a screener would look.
No mechanical or rapid-prototyping hardware work shown (no 3D printing, laser cutting or designed mechanical part), against a role that lists mechanical/electromechanical prototyping first.
llm_analysis.reasoning: Candidate's integration, validation, sensor and actuator work lines up well with four of the six responsibilities, and the bonus list is nearly fully covered. The real risks are eligibility (graduated vs currently pursuing) and the absence of any stated soldering or mechanical prototyping, so apply only after confirming the role accepts recent graduates.
